prompt:
Desktop landing page, first viewport only, 1536x1024, for "LEWORD" — a Korean blog keyword discovery tool by Leaders Pro. Keep the exact brand identity of the reference screenshot: near-black ground (#0a0a0f), bright gold (#FFD700 to #FFA500 gradient) for the primary accent, a cool mint (#44d7b6) for secondary data highlights, dark slate cards (#12121a) with soft 1px borders, clean Korean sans-serif type (like Pretendard), generous spacing. Top navigation bar like the reference (logo "Leaders Pro" left, menu items right).

STRUCTURE (leads the composition): a confident left-aligned headline in Korean "고수 블로그보다 한 수 위의 제목, 오늘 바로" with a short subline "실제로 재서 찾은 키워드와, 고수 제목을 넘는 제목만 남깁니다". Below it two buttons: a gold filled button "맛보기 시작" and an outlined button "월 19,900원으로 시작".
The right two-thirds is the hero proof: a large side-by-side comparison panel. Left column labeled "고수 블로그 제목" shows 3 muted grey title rows. Right column labeled "LEWORD 제목" shows 3 bright title rows, each with a small gold tag line starting with "↑" (like "↑ 고수 5명이 안 다룬 '서류·준비물'까지"). Between the columns a thin gold divider with a small "VS". Above the panel a small chip row: "검색량 11,320 · 문서수 3,210 · 실측" in mint.
At the bottom edge, a slim strip of three small proof chips: "구매 후기", "수익 인증", "웹 · PC 앱".
No ads, no stock photos of people, no fake logos or press marks, no invented statistics beyond the sample numbers shown. Crisp, premium, modern SaaS craft, high contrast, readable Korean text.
